name: postgresql_high_rollback_rate_otel
title: PostgreSQL high rollback rate
description: More than 10% of transactions in a database rolled back over the last 10 minutes, while the database committed more than one transaction per second. This often means application errors or constraint violations.

query_condition.promql: (sum by (service_instance_id, postgresql_database_name) (rate(postgresql_rollbacks[10m])) / (sum by (service_instance_id, postgresql_database_name) (rate(postgresql_commits[10m])) + sum by (service_instance_id, postgresql_database_name) (rate(postgresql_rollbacks[10m])))) and on (service_instance_id, postgresql_database_name) (sum by (service_instance_id, postgresql_database_name) (rate(postgresql_commits[10m])) > 1)
